caption: The drawing displays three views of a single metallic object arranged on a vertical sheet with a plain off-white background. Below this is a side view of the same object, showing its three legs, two of which curve downward at the ends, while the third is shorter and also curved. To the right of the top-down view, there is a small scale bar for measurement reference. The lower left corner of the sheet contains the name “CHAS. GARJIAN.” written in small, simple lettering. The overall composition is clean, with the object centrally positioned and no additional decorations or background elements.
